critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL (now fixed): backend/server.py ServiceCategory Enum was out of sync with seed_data.py CATEGORIES - any newly seeded category (Pet Care, Pest Control, Smart Home) would cause 500 ResponseValidationError on GET /api/services and GET /api/services/category/{newCat}. Recommend deriving the enum dynamically from categories collection or, at minimum, treat 'category' as plain str in Service model since the categories collection is the source of truth.
server.py still uses @app.on_event('shutdown') (deprecated in FastAPI - migrate to lifespan handlers).
Order number generation `INV-{order_count + 345678}` is race-prone (count_documents not atomic).
datetime stored as ISO string in DB then converted back on every read - consider native BSON datetimes.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/backend/server.py defined ServiceCategory Enum with the OLD 5 categories (AC, Listrik, Plumbing, Cleaning, 'Pet Servis'). When /app/backend/seed_data.py was updated to seed 7 NEW categories including 'Pet Care', 'Pest Control', 'Smart Home', the Service Pydantic response_model validation failed for any service whose category string was not in the enum, returning HTTP 500 ResponseValidationError. REPRODUCTION: GET /api/services -> 500; GET /api/services/category/Smart Home -> 500 (DB query succeeds but response serialization fails). MITIGATION: Updated enum to include all 7 category values. Long-term recommendation: drop the enum and use plain str on the Service model, deferring validity to the categories collection (which is the actual source of truth).
